Provider/pipeline seam for the bounded live slice:
TextExecution.Profile.from(authorization: LiveAuthorization.OpenAiCompatible, maxTokens: Long, timeoutMillis: Long): Either[String, Profile]. Profile.decode(json: Json): Either[String,Profile]. Profile exposes provider, model, maxTokens, timeoutMillis, json: Json, digest: Checksum and key(system:String,prompt:String):RecordingKey. Live derivation binds credential-free effective endpoint digest, provider/model, wire version, token budget; recorded descriptor decode needs no secrets. No fallback to v1.
TextExecution.live(recordings: Recordings, profile: Profile, authorization: LiveAuthorization.OpenAiCompatible): Either[String, Session]. Recheck exact profile against authorization before dispatch. Own the exclusive writer FileLock and derive the journal location from recordings.dir; do not accept an independent journal path. TextExecution.replay(recordings,profile):Session has no client.
Session.serve(system:String,prompt:String):Either[ExchangeFailure,ModelReply]; Session.clientInvocations:Int; Session.httpAttempts:Int; Session.cacheHits:Int; Session.receipt:Json; Session.close():Unit. Receipt contains per-exchange status, keys, actual client invocations and HTTP attempts started, provider-reported model/usage where available, unknown usage explicitly absent for failures. No prompt/reply text or credentials in the receipt. HTTP counts instrument the existing OpenAiCompatibleModelClient just before actual sends; legacy default behavior stays unchanged. Caller counters are not HTTP counts.
Before a new call persist Started; atomically persist reply before exposing it. A valid recording wins over a stale Started marker. Missing record plus Started/terminal failure refuses automatic repeat. Corrupt recording refuses without a call. Concurrent live sessions fail lock acquisition. New typed ExchangeFailure cases may represent uncertain/previous-failure; preserve legacy cases and parser behavior.
ModelRequest checked text factory derives key and exact messages from Profile; no public caller-supplied key.
Pipeline preflights all inputs and prompt/chunk validation before live factory; binds exact input and descriptor hashes in run.json and refuses changed-config resume. Same StudyReplay.session and one shared bundle renderer serve legacy/live/replay. Per-invocation receipt is separate from deterministic record/prediction output. Bundle modelCalls is actual per-session live client invocations (0 on replay), with descriptor identity in added provenance; record digests/predictions, not accounting metadata, are the replay equivalence claim.
Synthetic HTTP consumer court is owned by parent. Worker owns only provider-agent files and provider tests. No real credentials, endpoints, process-spawning, dependency updates or Mote mutations in worker scope.
